status: Frozen before E3 execution; all seven experiments previously inspected. Retrospective method development, not independent biological confirmation.
aim: Test whether early temporal validation can select a useful calibration or retain raw predictions without consulting late test outcomes.
base_fitting: For each of four original training experiments, exclude it entirely from base fitting and select ridge lambda by leave-one-experiment-out CV among the remaining three. For original test experiments, use the original all-four training fit. Scaling is fitted only on each fitting fold; equal experiment weight; original E1 lambda grid and features.
gate: Fit offset and nonnegative affine on targets <=72. Evaluate methods on origins >=84 with targets <=120. Choose the lowest early validation MSE, ties raw then offset then affine. Apply correction only if early relative MSE reduction is strictly greater than threshold. Refit chosen correction on targets <=120. A secondary frozen-fit policy retains its <=72 coefficients, using the same threshold.
threshold_selection: Using only the four training-experiment out-of-fold primary configurations, minimize equal-experiment mean late MSE/raw MSE for the refitted policy; tie break by lower worst ratio then higher threshold. Freeze one threshold globally before late test evaluation. Report all threshold training risks and all primary test threshold sensitivities without changing the selected threshold.
evaluation: Report all experiment/model/offset/horizon cases and late time bins, including harm. Test experiments remain previously seen, not a blind external holdout. No p-values or confidence intervals treating cells/windows as independent. Gate uses only observations through target frame120. Future availability is used for evaluability, not for method selection.
resource: Colab CPU, pinned Python3.12 NumPy2.2.6 SciPy1.15.3, one BLAS thread, large data remote only.
failure_policy: Preserve failed checks and all outcomes; no outcome-driven expansion, rerun or threshold replacement. A raw winner or failed transport closes this declared study as an informative result.
